seatedToss.guidance: Suidd ec bord as goll er y chooilley thie-ny-thie dy chur baag pheesyn bog ayns y targaid mooar. Goaill y tollyn er paper, cheilley.
seatedToss.stepsHeading: Cre'n dooyrt eh ny ta ny cheumyn
steps: Priuntey y targaid as y duillag tollyn, as cur eh er-lhieu er y bord eddyr shiu.
Suidd dy aashtagh, unnane ry-cheer dy row. Goll er thie-ny-thie gys oddys bog moghrey, ny jean nagh vel shiu gaghtyn dy ghoaill.
Tra vees bog currit ayns cearclan, cur tic ayns vaarkey e cholleen, er lhean y chearclan shen.
Smooin er y tickeyn cheilley tra vees shiu er stoh, my ta shiu geddyn cairys. Cha vel nyn oik dy chur shuim ayns rud erbee.
Stop tra vees unnane ny-yeigh dy ghoaill.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Cur baag gyn cheer-yn-ny-stoh ny stockan ruggit ayns, suidd ec y bord, cha vel bog cheet dy chur gys aghyn, as bee fer aosh ry-akin. Ta peiceyn beggey cur peiligh son y sharn.
flags: Cha vel son fo 3: peiceyn beggey
Cur er gheiy veih y veeal
safety: Ymmyrr baag lesh cheer shiaulit, ny stockan glen ruggit ayns. Jean ynsagh er toullyn ny stiprey lheeah er sheshaght, dy bee nagh vel ny lheead cheet magh.
Ta pheesyn, reesh as lheadyn beggey elley peiligh son y sharn. Cur ad er gheiy veih clyst beggey as veih fer erbee ta cur rudyn ayns e veeal.
Bee shiu ry-akin dy ghoaill, as jean shiu er smooinaght mychione ny rudyn ta ben ayns y veeal.
Jean suidd. Goll moghrey as isal gys y targaid er y bord, cha vel gys aghyn.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Y duillag priuntit: targaid jeh tree cearclanyn ennyssit Fagys, Eddyr as Feer, veih y ghiare stiagh, as tollyn cheet cholleen son pobble as lhean vaarkeyn foon son pobble cearclan.

sortTogether.hint: Oddagh yn {name|lower} goll ayns "{basket}". Crig er y vascaid shen dy chur eh ayn.
sortTogether.sorted: Ta dagh ooilley nhee reillt. Jeeagh trooid ny bascaidyn ry-cheilley, ny prow bun-chooish elley.
sortTogether.largerOn: Ta ny targaidyn smoo ry-hoie. Cha nel rud er ghoo.
sortTogether.largerOff: Ny targaidyn smoo dy hoie. Cha nel rud er ghoo.
sortTogether.largerOnNewRound: Ta ny targaidyn smoo ry-hoie, lesh daa vaskaid. Ayns shoh dreemyn noa son ny hassyn.

picturePuzzle.guidance: Crig er un veer, eisht crig er meer elley. T'ad caghlaa ynnydyn.
picturePuzzle.pickedUp: Meer troggit. Nish crig er yn ynnyd lhisagh ee goll.
picturePuzzle.whole: Ta'n {name|lower} slane reesht. Reih jalloo elley tra sailliu.

picturePuzzle.guideText: Shoh myr ta'n jalloo jeeaghyn tra t'eh slane.
picturePuzzle.ownBack: Dy geddyn daue ny dreemyn ain
picturePuzzle.ownPrivacy: Ta dty dreeym-ghrian ec y ynsagh shoh. Cha vel eh currit er-lhieu ny sheyrt.
picturePuzzle.ownConsent: Cur dreemyn-ghrian dty hoyl. Foddee oo goll dy hoie er mannagh vel persoon ayns y dreeym nagh vel gra dy haase, eisht jeeagh dy gherrey.
picturePuzzle.ownNotUsable: Cha daink y coyrt shen y ghoaill. Goll coyrt dreeym-ghrian, myr JPEG ny PNG.
picturePuzzle.ownWhole: Ta dty dreeym-ghrian ry-hoie arragh. Cur dy vollaghtey arrey cha bee yn tra shen toiyr dy hoie.
picturePuzzle.ownSheetHow: Gearr er ny loayrtyn. Mollaghtey ny pioysyn, eisht cur daa pioys er ghoo ec y chooilley cur, nish tra t'y dreeym ry-hoie.
picturePuzzle.done: Ta'n jalloo slane reesht. Cloie reesht ny gow aash.

finishTheSaying.guidance: Lhaih yn raa ry-cheilley, eisht crig er y fockle ta cur jerrey er.
finishTheSaying.otherEnding: Ta "{word}" obbraghey myrgeddin. Dy cadjin ta'n raa goaill jerrey lesh "{end}".

wordSearch.guidance: Ta focklyn goll tessen ny sheese. Crig er kied lettyr y 'ockle, eisht er y lettyr s'jerree echey.
wordSearch.letterChosen: Lettyr {letter} reiht. Nish crig er lettyr s'jerree y 'ockle.
wordSearch.foundAll: {word} feddynit. Shen dagh ooilley 'ockle. Cloie reesht ny gow aash.
wordSearch.tryAgain: Gow dty hraa. Crig er kied lettyr y 'ockle, eisht er y lettyr s'jerree echey.
wordSearch.gridLabel: Greid lettyryn, {n} straih dy {n} lettyr. Jean ymmyd jeh ny bocsyn-saighead dy ghleashaght eddyr lettyryn.
wordSearch.sheetNote: Ta focklyn goll tessen ny sheese.
wordSearch.unavailable: Cha nel greid lettyryn jannoo cooie da'n çhengey shoh, myr shen cha nel shirrey fockle ry-gheddyn ayns shoh. Prow ny cloieyn jalloo ayns ynnyd jeh.

coloring.guidance: Crig er daah, eisht crig er meer jeh'n jalloo.

conversationCards.guidance: Lhaih yn caart magh ard. Cha nel reggyrt kiart erbee ayn.
conversationCards.showPrompt: Cur er dy hoie cooinaght son yn çhengey
conversationCards.groupSit: Suidh ayns cearkey ayns y ynnyd ta ny persoonyn uile geearree yn dreeym. Yn persoon ta jannoo yn chart, ny yn inneen lesh yn dreeym mooar, ta shen goll ec y chied.
conversationCards.groupPass: Eisht cur y chart dys yn chied persoon elley. Dy chooilley persoon gra fockle ny cabbyl mygeayrt y dreeym, eisht cur y chart er-lhieu.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Ta cur y chart er-lhieu bee ta cur mie dy jeant. Foddee persoon lhig ghoaill gyn gra rud, as cha vel nane er-ghoo dy gra cree eh.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Ta'n roo jeant tra vees y chairt er ghoaill cooar y chiaull, ny tra vees y ghroop er n-aggle. Cha vel neb er ennagh. Stad tra vees y ghroop kiarit.

photoPairs.guidance: Crig er fotograf, eisht crig er yn fer ta co-reggyrt rish.
photoPairs.intro: **Reih 2 dys 6 fotografyn** ass y saase shoh. Cha nel ad ry-akin agh er y duillag shoh as cha nel ad laadit seose ny sauailt rieau.
photoPairs.cleared: Fotografyn glennit ass y duillag shoh.
photoPairs.atLeastTwo: Reih er y chooid sloo daa 'otograf, my sailliu.
photoPairs.usingFirst: Jannoo ymmyd jeh ny kied {max} fotografyn.

skipped.one: Cha row {count} choadan ny 'otograf oddys mayd y haishbyney.
skipped.two: Cha row {count} choadan ny fotografyn oddys mayd y haishbyney.
skipped.few: Cha row {count} coadanyn ny fotografyn oddys mayd y haishbyney.
skipped.many: Cha row {count} coadanyn ny fotografyn oddys mayd y haishbyney.
skipped.other: Cha row {count} coadanyn ny fotografyn oddys mayd y haishbyney.

photoPairs.playAgain: Cloie reesht lesh ny fotografyn shoh
photoPairs.empty: Heeish dty 'otografyn ayns shoh, dagh fer jeu daa cheayrt.

pictureBingo.guidance: Clouee ny caartyn hoshiaght. Eisht taishbynee yn eamerey shoh er y scailhean smoo t'eu.
pictureBingo.start: Crig er "Yn chied jalloo elley" dy eam yn chied jalloo.
pictureBingo.allCalled: Ta dagh jalloo er ny eam

calmBreathing.guidance: Tayrn-jee stiagh nyn ennal tra ta'n kiarkyl gaase, as magh tra t'eh gaase ny sloo. T'eh scuirr liorish hene lurg shey ennalyn.
calmBreathing.ready: Aarloo tra vees shiu hene aarloo
calmBreathing.started: Er doshiaght. Tayrn-jee stiagh nyn ennal tra ta'n kiarkyl gaase.
calmBreathing.finished: Shen va shey ennalyn moalley. Toshee-jee reesht tra sailliu.

storyChain.guidance: Goll ayns ghoaill: aght dy derrey dagh unnane, as cur ynsagh ry-cheet ayns dagh mirrt.
storyChain.passNote: Abbyr shiu dty raaraght ard. Cha vel cur sheeaght ny cadjagh er dy ghoaill. Ta dagh neb gow y lhie er aght.
storyChain.fullAdd: Ta'n ghoaill lane. Tosh ayns ghoaill noa
storyChain.takeOff: Gow y chied unnane er y hrail
storyChain.added: Ta'n {name|lower} nish ayns cooar y ghoaill.
storyChain.removed: Ta'n {name|lower} er n-y-hoilt veih y ghoaill.
storyChain.full: Ta ochtoo ynsyn ayns y ghoaill. Insh y sceal slane, ny tosh ayns ghoaill noa.

pictures.sunrise: Irree ny greiney harrish ny cruink
